D.t: Emily Randall leads by 27.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 75,366 votes; a one point swing is about 1,395 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +18.4 and D +35.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$210K cash against $3K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
